main.description: A personal public statement authored by a member, published from the member's own repo. Unlike a post it is a standalone declaration rather than a feed/thread unit; it may point back at the internal artifact it was published from.

text.description: The statement body, in plain text.

topic.description: Optional: a short free-text topic the statement addresses.

canonicalUri.description: Optional: link to the internal artifact this statement was published from.
